{{Quote|Assure your employer he'll be reunited with Muchi soon.|Cid, to Bib Fortuna|<ref name="Rampage" />}}
'''Muchi''' was an adolescent [[Gender|female]] [[rancor]] owned by [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba the Hutt]]. At some point, she was captured by [[Zygerrian]] [[enslaver]]s and taken to the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] [[planet]] [[Ord Mantell]].<ref name="Rampage" /> In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' places the events of [[The Bad Batch Season 1|''The Bad Batch'' Season 1]] in [[19 BBY]].</ref> Jabba's [[majordomo]], [[Bib Fortuna]], hired the former [[Jedi]] [[Information broker|informant]] [[Ciddarin Scaleback]] to return the rancor to them. Cid, in turn, hired [[Clone Force 99]] to [[Mission to Ord Mantell (Clone Force 99)|complete]] the job. Muchi was released by [[Omega]], and returned to Bib Fortuna,<ref name="Rampage" /> who cared about the rancor and called her his "sweet girl."<ref name="AudioDescription Rampage">Per the Audio Description for "[[Rampage (episode)|Rampage]]" available on [[Disney+]].</ref>

==Biography==
Muchi was an adolescent [[Gender|female]] [[rancor]] owned by the [[Hutt]] [[gangster]] and [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].<ref name="Rampage" /> During or prior to [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Muchi was captured by [[Zygerrian]] [[enslaver]]s led by [[Raney]] and she was taken to [[Old Ord Mantell City]] on the [[planet]] [[Ord Mantell]]. [[Bib Fortuna]], Jabba's [[majordomo]], hired [[Trandoshan]] [[Cid's Parlor|parlor]] owner [[Ciddarin Scaleback|Cid]] to return Muchi to Jabba. Cid then hired rogue [[clone commando]] unit [[Clone Force 99]] to bring Muchi to her in exchange for some information they required, but failed to add that Muchi was a rancor. They also agreed to split the [[bounty]] for Muchi between them, with Cid receiving a larger portion. With arrangements made, Cid threw an [[intel stick]] at Clone Force 99's leader, [[Hunter]], that contained the details on the bounty.<ref name="Rampage" />

Clone Force 99 traveled to the ruins of Old Ord Mantell City in their personal [[Shuttle|attack shuttle]], the [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|''Marauder'']], and used their [[macrobinoculars]] to observe several [[Slavery|slaves]], including a [[Color|green]] [[Falleen]] [[Unidentified Falleen child|child]] they mistook to be Muchi. However, before they could attack, they were ambushed by a large [[brezak]] and captured in a [[stun net]] fired from an [[electrified net gun]] by the Zygerrians.<ref name="Rampage" />

During Clone Force 99's mission, Fortuna contacted Cid to inquire about the delay as his master was becoming impatient. Cid told Fortuna to reassure his master that he will be reunited with Muchi soon.<ref name="Rampage" />

[[File:BigHug-Rampage.png|thumb|left|300px|Wrecker grappling with Muchi to establish dominance]]
In an effort to rescue the [[prisoner]]s, Clone Force 99's [[Youngling|young]] companion, [[Omega]], unlocked the cage that Muchi was kept in, but in the process was grabbed by a [[Zygerrian Royal Guard|Zygerrian guard]]. Despite the Zygerrians' efforts to lock the cage, Muchi broke out of her chains and escaped. The slavers then fired their weapons at Muchi, causing her to throw a large boulder at them, while the [[Cloning|clones]] used the distraction to break free of their chains and rip off their [[shock collar]]s. Muchi tried to attack Raney, but a brezak flew the Zygerrian away. Omega told the Falleen child whom she believed to be Muchi that they would take her home. However, a [[Unidentified Falleen prisoner|Falleen prisoner]] quickly informed her that the rancor was in fact Muchi, much to [[Echo]]'s surprise.<ref name="Rampage" />

Muchi quickly defeated several of the Zygerrians before battling Raney and the brezak. Though outmatched by the [[lizard]] while it was mounted, Muchi gained the advantage after Hunter threw Raney to the ground. The brezak gave chase when Muchi attempted to flee, with the two creatures engaging in a fight, which Muchi won by biting the brezak's tail. Following this, [[Wrecker]] challenged Muchi to a fight due to the fact that rancors adhered to a social hierarchy, in which the strongest contender was the group alpha. After a lengthy duel, both dropped from exhaustion.<ref name="Rampage" />

[[File:AHappyReunion-Rampage.png|thumb|right|300px|The Bad Batch return Muchi to Bib Fortuna.]]
Clone Force 99 brought Muchi to [[Ord Mantell City]], where she was greeted by Fortuna and two [[Gamorrean]] guards, with one of Gamorreans paying Cid for Muchi's rescue. The rancor bid the clones farewell and was taken home by Fortuna. In exchange for completing the mission, Cid told Hunter that the [[bounty hunter]] the group had [[Chase on Pantora|encountered]] before was [[Fennec Shand]], and that she was working on a direct commission. Cid then gave Hunter his share of the payment.<ref name="Rampage" />

==Personality and traits==
Muchi was a female rancor in an adolescent stage of development, who was roughly 1.82 [[meter]]s tall.<ref name="Muchi" /> She had brown skin and green [[eye]]s. Muchi disliked the Zygerrian slavers, particularly Raney, due to their kidnapping of her.<ref name="Rampage" /> Muchi was a formidable opponent who fought until she was exhausted and docile,<ref name="Muchi" /> though she could also be tamed and ridden. Muchi enjoyed the affection of Bib Fortuna and later Omega and Clone Force 99.<ref name="Rampage" />

==Behind the scenes==
Muchi appeared in "[[Rampage (episode)|Rampage]]," the fifth episode of the [[The Bad Batch Season 1|first season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''.<ref name="Rampage" /> ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'' identified Jabba's rancor in the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] as "[[Pateesa]] Muchi."<ref name="LEGO">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]''</ref>
